title: For centuries, bird migration was a mystery – a tech revolution is changing that, and could help save these amazing creatures

problems: insight 2 has a figure, so its body must be <= 20 words; it has 26. Cut 6+ words or drop the figure

slide 3: "About 6.5 million of 79 million banded birds were recovered" is not supported by SOURCE. Source says 'more than 79 million' banded; the draft drops 'more than' (slide says 79 million), a minor imprecision, but acceptable rounding—however the figure is fine; see note: this is actually supported.

slide 4: "Tracking and bird-watcher reports show migration almost in real time" is not supported by SOURCE. Source says journeys can be seen almost in real time generally, but does not specifically attribute that to tracking devices plus bird-watcher reports; loosely tied, though broadly consistent.
